text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-saa~n! Please do your best this 
autumn season as well~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I prepared a banner woven from the finest 
gold thread, perfect for McQueen-san's 
brilliance~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Thank you very much. I will 
continue to devote myself daily to live up 
to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan C
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Even the way she waves is 
gorgeous... McQueen's elegance knows no 
bounds~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I haven't spoken directly with her 
Trainer, who serves as her coach, but... 
I'm sure he must be a wonderful person as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I haven't spoken directly with her 
Trainer, who serves as her coach, but... 
I'm sure she must be a wonderful person as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan E
text_block_list.text:
I am sure they possess both impeccable 
manners and dignity! After all, 
McQueen-san chose them, so they would 
never say anything unseemly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A chill ran down my spine. If by some 
chance I ended up disillusioning Mejiro 
McQueen's fans, and on top of that...
choice_data_list:
(What if even McQueen is disappointed in 
me...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer? What's with that tone of 
voice?
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! That was pretty weird of me, huh!
S-Sorry! That was weird, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A blunder like this is utterly out of the 
question. I must master refined speech and 
proper conduct as soon as humanly 
possible...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fans
text_block_list.text: (...Murmurs, whispers...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you have a moment? I have a 
proposal for today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Shall we move elsewhere first? We stand 
out far too much here."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Coming out this far, there's nobody 
around, is there?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ei!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, I have prepared a water gun for you 
as well! Please, splash me with all the 
water you desire!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It means exactly what it sounds like! 
Look, you're wide open!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ei, ei, hup!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No turning back now! Fufu... come on, 
hurry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Mejiro McQueen won't listen to 
reason. In that case, just as she says—
choice_data_list: Got it, but no take-backs for you either!
Got it, but no take-backs for you either!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm completely soaked through~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Please don't apologize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Because you always face me so earnestly 
like that, I am able to stay true to who I 
am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. You are already a wonderful 
person as you are. There is no need to 
strain yourself so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Because you are the Trainer of Mejiro 
McQueen, chosen by none other than 
myself."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Shall I take a photo of your face right 
now, so that you can remember it anytime?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu. In that case, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa, McQueen-san is soaking wet!? 
Whatever happened to you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ! Ah, ahh... this is... Um...
choice_data_list: This is special training for the fall

text_block_list.text:
"My, oh my! Is that so! As expected of 
McQueen and the others! So truly 
thoughtful~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Oh, Trainer, really.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if I really should have taken a 
photo back then."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Your expression has become much more 
gallant than before."

text_block_list.text: And the next day—

text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! McQueen-san's Trainer carries

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fan B
text_block_list.text:

is simply magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Without any fuss, just as they always are. 
My Trainer is truly wonderful, wouldn't 
you agree?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So please, don't push yourself anymore, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm glad.

text_block_list.text:
Because an overly stiff and formal version

? Isn't it just business as usual? I mean, 
the one you're with is your Trainer, 
right?

text_block_list.text: Why is everyone here～?!

Blushing furiously, Mejiro McQueen ran off 
toward the Mejiro family Umamusume hiding 
behind the rocks.
